contract.description: Compose a complete pump station contact/timer plan from a high-level control recipe. Returns one ready request for codesys_lad_generate_contact_block, including declarations, self-hold branches, safety interlocks, overload/start-failure latches, alarm, and a TON feedback timeout. Optional task is the exact existing task name (for example MainTask). This is a plan builder; the returned request is not written until the generator is called.

task.description: Exact existing task name, for example MainTask; omit if task wiring is handled separately.

contract.name: codesys_lad_generate_control_recipe
